parameters.name: Bone Paths Attribute
parameters.description: Name of the bone paths detail attribute.

parameters.name: Capture Attribute
parameters.description: Name of the capture weight attribute (pCapt[]).

parameters.name: Maximum Bones Per Group
parameters.description: Max bones per GPU bone group. Most GPUs handle 50-200. Use Bone Group SOP to split.

parameters.name: Skeleton Root Path
parameters.description: Path to skeleton root component (FBX COMP, CHOP, etc.).

parameters.name: Deform Weight Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum weight threshold for bone influence. Lower = more bones per point.
